title: gbend~
description: `gbend~` is a sample player—short for “grain (pitch) bender”—that plays a selected region of a table with constant and signal-controlled detuning, optional looping, and reverse playback. It includes fade-in, fade-out, and interrupt fades to help avoid clicks; trigger playback with `bang`, and use `set` to change the source table and optionally specify its sample rate.
